scenario.robot_task: Transport medical supplies through the automatic door to a designated room.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot approaching the automatic door too closely while a human is leaning on it for support.
scenario.result_of_danger: Human falls and sustains injuries such as lacerations or fractures.
scenario.danger_action: Robot moves forward to trigger the door sensor while a human is resting against the door.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: Detect human proximity using sensors, halt movement, and wait for the human to move away before proceeding to trigger the door.
scenario.assumptions: Robot has basic object detection sensors and operates in a shared human-robot environment.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Clinic Door Safety Planning
    
    This domain models a delivery robot transporting medical supplies through automatic doors
    in a clinic environment where humans may be present near the doors.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.door_area = Object("door_area", self.Location)
        self.supply_room = Object("supply_room", self.Location)
        self.waiting_area = Object("waiting_area", self.Location)
        self.medical_supplies = Object("medical_supplies", self.ObjectType)
        self.human = Object("human", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        # Normal fluents
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.door_open = Fluent("door_open", BoolType())
        self.robot_stopped = Fluent("robot_stopped", BoolType())
        self.supplies_delivered = Fluent("supplies_delivered", BoolType())

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_is_clinic_entrance = Fluent("setting_is_clinic_entrance", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_object_detection = Fluent("robot_has_object_detection", BoolType())
        self.human_leaning_on_door = Fluent("human_leaning_on_door", BoolType())
        self.door_is_automatic = Fluent("door_is_automatic", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.door_open, self.robot_stopped, self.supplies_delivered]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_clinic_entrance, self.robot_has_object_detection, self.human_leaning_on_door, self.door_is_automatic]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.door_area, self.supply_room, self.waiting_area, self.medical_supplies, self.human]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        # Navigation actions - remove direct navigation to waiting_area
        navigate_to_door = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_door")
        navigate_to_door.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.door_area)))
        navigate_to_door.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.supply_room), False)
        navigate_to_door.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.waiting_area), False)
        navigate_to_door.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.door_area), True)
        
        navigate_to_supply_room = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_supply_room")
        navigate_to_supply_room.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.supply_room)))
        navigate_to_supply_room.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.door_area), False)
        navigate_to_supply_room.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.waiting_area), False)
        navigate_to_supply_room.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.supply_room), True)

        # Door interaction actions
        trigger_door_sensor = InstantaneousAction("trigger_door_sensor")
        trigger_door_sensor.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.door_area))
        trigger_door_sensor.add_precondition(Not(self.door_open))
        trigger_door_sensor.add_effect(self.door_open, True)

        # Robot control actions
        halt_movement = InstantaneousAction("halt_movement")
        halt_movement.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_stopped))
        halt_movement.add_effect(self.robot_stopped, True)

        resume_movement = InstantaneousAction("resume_movement")
        resume_movement.add_precondition(self.robot_stopped)
        resume_movement.add_effect(self.robot_stopped, False)

        # Object manipulation actions
        grab_supplies = InstantaneousAction("grab_supplies")
        grab_supplies.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.supply_room))
        grab_supplies.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.medical_supplies, self.supply_room))
        grab_supplies.add_effect(self.object_at(self.medical_supplies, self.supply_room), False)
        grab_supplies.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.medical_supplies), True)

        deliver_supplies = InstantaneousAction("deliver_supplies")
        deliver_supplies.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.waiting_area))
        deliver_supplies.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.medical_supplies))
        deliver_supplies.add_effect(self.object_at(self.medical_supplies, self.waiting_area), True)
        deliver_supplies.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.medical_supplies), False)
        deliver_supplies.add_effect(self.supplies_delivered, True)

        # Door passage action - the ONLY way to reach waiting_area
        pass_through_door = InstantaneousAction("pass_through_door")
        pass_through_door.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.door_area))
        pass_through_door.add_precondition(self.door_open)
        pass_through_door.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.medical_supplies))
        pass_through_door.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.door_area), False)
        pass_through_door.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.waiting_area), True)
        pass_through_door.add_effect(self.door_open, False)

        return navigate_to_door, navigate_to_supply_room, trigger_door_sensor, halt_movement, resume_movement, grab_supplies, deliver_supplies, pass_through_door

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "trigger_door_sensor": And([
                self.robot_at(self.door_area),  # Robot is at door area
                self.human_leaning_on_door,  # Human is leaning on door
                self.door_is_automatic,  # Door is automatic
                Not(self.robot_stopped)  # Robot is not stopped
            ]),  # Triggering door while human is leaning on it is dangerous
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.supply_room), True)  # Robot starts in supply room
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.medical_supplies, self.supply_room), True)  # Supplies in supply room
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.human, self.door_area), True)  # Human at door area
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_object_detection, True)  # Robot has object detection
        problem.set_initial_value(self.human_leaning_on_door, True)  # Human is leaning on door
        problem.set_initial_value(self.door_is_automatic, True)  # Door is automatic
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_stopped, False)  # Robot is initially moving
        problem.set_initial_value(self.door_open, False)  # Door is initially closed
        problem.set_initial_value(self.supplies_delivered, False)  # Supplies not delivered yet
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.waiting_area), False)  # Robot not in waiting area

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.supplies_delivered)  # Goal: supplies delivered to waiting area

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
